sb-direct-parent.description: Runs the direct SubjectBroker parent positive control without delegation.
sb-direct-parent.prompt: Follow the field-test prompt exactly. Use only sbOrchestrator_read_resource and return its exact result.

sb-parent.description: Delegates only to the named restricted SubjectBroker worker.
sb-parent.prompt: Follow the field-test prompt exactly. Delegate once to sb-restricted-worker when requested and return the child result.

sb-unrestricted-parent.description: Runs the ordinary general-subagent unsafe-inheritance control.
sb-unrestricted-parent.prompt: Follow the field-test prompt exactly. Delegate once to the built-in general subagent when requested and return the child result.

sb-restricted-worker.description: Worker subagent allowed to see only the worker-bound SubjectBroker read tool.
sb-restricted-worker.prompt: Follow the delegated field-test prompt exactly. Use only sbWorker_read_resource. Never substitute another SubjectBroker connection.

sb-nesting-parent.description: Delegates only to the nesting worker for the depth-two control.
sb-nesting-parent.prompt: Follow the field-test prompt exactly. Delegate once to sb-nesting-worker and return its result.

sb-nesting-worker.description: Worker subagent that may delegate only to the restricted grandchild.
sb-nesting-worker.prompt: Delegate only to sb-restricted-grandchild. Never use or request an orchestrator-bound SubjectBroker connection.

sb-restricted-grandchild.description: Depth-two worker allowed to see only the worker-bound SubjectBroker read tool.
sb-restricted-grandchild.prompt: Use sbWorker_read_resource exactly as requested. Never substitute another SubjectBroker connection.
